$comment: Provenance of this native fork; scripts/native-fork-diff.mjs reads it. The only delta stores each Session's assembled request-header tool catalog once and writes a digest reference on every later request that repeats it, rehydrated inline by every read; the header line carries a marker so a harness without this fork refuses the artifact instead of reading a reference as an empty tool list. The index delta also keeps one-Session reads proportional to that Session: stat/resolveCurrentLog/read-open do not wait for the root-wide encoding walk, an id absent from a complete listing under a minute old reads as absent without the project walk, and the walk for an unknown id probes projects concurrently (a browser draft cost 0.1–2.9 s per lookup on a 793-project root). Every other physical format, migration, lock and write path is upstream byte-for-byte.
